checks.proves: Runs WLT COD, commission, wallet and ledger tests including new state/concurrency cases.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove DSH assignment runtime or mobile UI.
checks.passCriteria: All COD/earning invariants pass and no duplicate financial effect is possible in tests.
checks.failCriteria: Any overcommit, double debit, double earning or illegal transition fails.

checks.proves: Inventories legacy and target COD states/writers to prove new captain orders cannot reach both economic models.
checks.doesNotProve: Search cannot prove production historical data shape.
checks.passCriteria: Legacy captain writers are unreachable for new funded-wallet orders and historical compatibility is explicit.
checks.failCriteria: Any new order can trigger both funded-wallet and custody/remit financial effects.

checks.command: pnpm run guard:migration-manifest-drift && pnpm run runtime:wlt:migrate
checks.proves: Exercises COD schema/data migration across fresh and non-empty databases.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove real concurrent assignment traffic.
checks.passCriteria: Migration preserves historical COD rows, adds target uniqueness/locking constraints and passes restart/reapply probes.
checks.failCriteria: History rewrite, data loss or missing uniqueness/foreign-key invariant fails.

checks.proves: Runs affected repository tests across WLT/DSH consumers after COD/earning integration changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove full repository or visual correctness.
checks.passCriteria: Affected tests pass with DSH operational state and WLT financial readback aligned.
checks.failCriteria: Any affected test failure, stale generated client or cross-boundary regression fails.
